hint.en: Fires when the recommended contiguous cost/carbon window begins. Uses cached published prices and regional carbon forecast data; fails closed if either horizon is incomplete.

Triggers when the current half-hour leaves your cheapest smart-charge plan.

hint.en: Triggers when grid carbon intensity falls below your threshold — a good time to use power.
Triggers when grid carbon intensity moves between very low / low / moderate / high / very high.
Triggers when fresh half-hourly prices become available (typically ~16:00) — schedule tonight's automations.

hint.en: True when an Economy 7 meter is on its cheaper night register (per the configured night window).

titleFormatted.en: The relative price band !{{is|is not}} [[band]]

hint.en: Compares the current price to the whole local tariff day (duration-weighted). False until the day is fully published.

titleFormatted.en: [[source]] data !{{is|isn't}} stale

hint.en: True when the selected Octopus data source hasn't refreshed within its expected window (the last known value is kept, not blanked). Use to warn when prices, consumption, carbon, balance or cost/billing data goes stale.

titleFormatted.en: Cost this month !{{is|isn't}} above £[[amount]]

hint.en: True when the settled month-to-date electricity cost is above the amount.

titleFormatted.en: Now !{{is|isn't}} in the cheapest [[duration]] h under [[max_price]] p/kWh before [[by]]

hint.en: True when now is one of the cheapest half-hours (up to your price cap) before the deadline. Forward prices are estimates; fails closed (false) if rates aren't published far enough ahead or the cap can't be met.

titleFormatted.en: Now !{{is|isn't}} in the recommended [[duration]] h window within [[within]] h at green weighting [[greenness]]

hint.en: True only while the normalized price/carbon recommendation is active. Forecast estimate; fails closed if published prices or carbon forecast data are incomplete.

titleFormatted.en: A smart-charge dispatch !{{starts|doesn't start}} within [[minutes]] min

hint.en: For Intelligent Octopus Go: true when Octopus has a planned dispatch (cheap smart-charge window) starting within the given minutes. Lets a target-rate Flow defer to the car's own schedule. Fails closed (false) if the dispatch data is stale.

titleFormatted.en: Plan [[mode]] slots below [[price]] p/kWh before [[by]], duration [[duration]] h, fallback [[fallback]] up to [[maximum]] p/kWh

hint.en: One persisted plan per meter, replacing its prior plan. 'all' ignores duration/fallback. 'duration' prefers cheap slots, optional bounded supplement. Replans preserve elapsed eligible duration, not measured charging. No battery commands or outbound requests.

title.en: Cancel the configured charging eligibility plan

hint.en: Removes only this meter's eligibility plan and emits run-ended if active. Does not itself stop a physical battery.

title.en: Get every cheap slot before a deadline

title.en: Get a bounded duration charging plan

hint.en: Prefer cheap slots; optional cheapest supplement up to the inclusive hard maximum. No partial plan is returned as complete. Zero is literal. Cached rates only; no charging commands.

title.en: Get every slot below a chosen price

titleFormatted.en: Get all slots below [[price]] p/kWh in the next [[within]] hours

hint.en: Cached prices only. All qualifying slots, with partial endpoints counted by remaining duration. Errors on incomplete/stale horizons. Does not control charging.
Immediately refresh prices, usage and balance from Octopus Energy.
Starts an immediate Intelligent Octopus Go boost charge on your EV/charger. Requires Intelligent Octopus Go and boost control to be enabled in the app settings (off by default).
Cancels an in-progress Intelligent Octopus Go boost charge and returns the EV/charger to smart control. Requires boost control to be enabled in the app settings (off by default).

hint.en: Returns the start time and average price of the cheapest block of half-hours ahead.

title.en: Plan the cheapest hours before a time

hint.en: Selects the cheapest (non-contiguous) half-hours between now and the given time.

title.en: Get the target-rate plan (cheapest hours under a cap)

titleFormatted.en: Get the cheapest [[duration]] h under [[max_price]] p/kWh before [[by]]

hint.en: Returns the cheapest half-hours (up to your price cap) before the deadline as tokens. If the cap can't be met, 'Target met' is false and 'Cheapest available' tells you the price you'd have to accept. Forward prices are estimates.

title.en: Get the next planned smart-charge dispatch

hint.en: For Intelligent Octopus Go: returns the next planned dispatch (cheap smart-charge window) as tokens. Fails if there is none or the data is stale. Planned dispatches are intent and can change.

titleFormatted.en: Plan charging [[needed_kwh]] kWh at [[charge_rate]] kW before [[by]]

hint.en: Picks the cheapest half-hours before the deadline to deliver the energy you need.

titleFormatted.en: Plan greenest charge of [[needed_kwh]] kWh at [[charge_rate]] kW before [[by]] at greenness [[greenness]]

hint.en: Picks one contiguous window balancing low price and forecast carbon. Green weighting 0 = cheapest, 1 = greenest. Fails closed if either forecast horizon is incomplete.

example.en: Estimate from published prices and carbon forecast; not a bill or settlement.

titleFormatted.en: Compare my tariff over the last [[days]] days

hint.en: Estimates a cheaper Octopus product from your recent usage. This is an ESTIMATE, not advice or a guaranteed saving — forward prices vary and eligibility (e.g. an EV tariff needs an EV). Review your own usage before switching.

example.en: based on 30 days of your usage. Estimate — not a guaranteed saving.

titleFormatted.en: Find the cheapest [[duration]] h slot in the next [[within]] h, ties [[tie_strategy]] (seed [[random_seed]])

hint.en: Cheapest contiguous block with an explicit tie strategy. Prices are tariff estimates, never a settled bill; negative prices are preserved.

example.en: Estimated plan — not a settled bill

titleFormatted.en: Plan [[needed_kwh]] kWh at [[charge_rate]] kW before [[by]], ties [[tie_strategy]] (seed [[random_seed]])

example.en: Estimated vs uniform-window baseline — not a settled bill
